name: cli-33-skill-query-triggers
note: pivot to haiku-4-5. Baseline is main's description.txt (pre-CLI-33).

description: main's description.txt (pre-CLI-33). Haiku-4-5. 8/22 positives trigger; precision still 1.0 thanks to specific aura-cli wording.

iter1 (haiku): the simple sonnet-winner description ('Runs Cypher and manages Neo4j Aura...'). Recall 0.36→0.68. Precision still 1.0. FNs concentrated in aura verbs (create/delete/provision) and credential set-up.

iter2 (haiku): explicit aura verbs (list/create/get/delete/provision/resize) + credential verbs (set up/add/remove) + 'execute or pipe Cypher'. Recall 0.68→0.77. Trade: aura 3→5/6, credential 0→2/2, query 8→6/9.
iter3 (DISCARD): add 'run' verb + 'including from a `*.env` file' hint. Mild regression (5 FNs jumped to 7 FNs at rate=1/3 borderline; longer description seems to make haiku less decisive).

iter4 (haiku): add trigger-phrase examples ('Mentions include: neo4j-cli, aura-cli, `neo4j query`, `aura instance`, `aura credential`, "run cypher against my db", "what's the schema of my neo4j", "list my aura instances"'). aura 5→6/6, schema 3/3, credential 2/2. Recall 0.77→0.82.
